versions.subject: Added a rule to detect the use of SettingSyncHost.exe to run hijacked binary
versions.detection:
system_utility:
    Image|startswith: 
        - 'C:\Windows\System32\'
        - 'C:\Windows\SysWOW64\'
parent_is_settingsynchost:
    ParentCommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'cmd.exe /c'
        - 'RoamDiag.cmd'
        - '-outputpath'
condition: not system_utility and parent_is_settingsynchost
